title: FloralisPots
description: Compatibility between Floralis and Botany Pots Mods
body:
This datapack enables Floralis cactus and flower seeds to work in Botany Pots, and for Botany Pots to accept plant fibers as fertilizer. If there are any problems, please let me know, this is my first datapack and I probably missed something somewhere. Designed for Minecraft Version 1.20.1, unlikely to load in older versions.

Requires [Botany Pots](https://modrinth.com/mod/botany-pots)

Requires [Floralis](https://modrinth.com/mod/floralis)

I highly recommend use of the Openloader mod to save you from installing this save by save.

Openloader can be found here:
[Curse](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/open-loader), [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/open-loader) 

Botany Pots and Openloader are made by [Darkhax](https://modrinth.com/user/Darkhax)

Floralis is made by [luxtracon](https://modrinth.com/user/luxtracon)

Linked mods are not associated with the datapack. I cannot address any bugs in either mod.

(BTW if either author would like to include this compat natively, please do! Just let me know so I can depricate this page)
